article.title: dKV Forcing: Separating Generation and Memory Representations through a Differentiable KV Cache
article.excerpt: A causal video generator writes every segment it produces into a key--value (KV) cache, and later segments know the past only through it. Self-rollout training stops the gradient at this cache, and Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) restores it, but applies it to the same weights that generate the current segment. We find that writing and generating are different roles: in a pretrained generator the…

article.title: Meta ads is now available in AWS Quick
article.excerpt: AWS Quick now has a Meta ads AI connector. Meta advertisers can use natural language in Quick to create, manage, and analyze campaigns while staying connected to the Meta ad management network, and combine Meta ad data with first- and third-party sources to build dashboards, documents, slide decks, and automated workflows.

fa.title: تبلیغات متا در AWS Quick در دسترس است

article.excerpt: Standard Bank Group automated the evidence behind its generative AI approval gates.
